title: 定语从句 · who/which/that 入门
intro: 8 页精讲：who 指人 · which/that 指物 · 定语从句修饰名词 · 小升初入门
psleNote: PSLE 定语从句入门考点 67+ 处；who/which/that 选择是核心。

examples.en: The boy who lives next door is my friend.
examples.zh: 住在隔壁的那个男孩是我的朋友。

examples.en: The book which is on the desk is mine.
The teacher who teaches us English is very kind.
examples.zh: 教我们的英语老师很和蔼。

examples.en: This is the film that we watched yesterday.
examples.zh: 这是我们昨天看的电影。

examples.en: The girl who sings well won first prize.
examples.zh: 唱歌好的女孩得了一等奖。

examples.en: The dog which barks at night keeps us awake.
examples.zh: 夜里叫的狗让我们睡不着。

examples.en: Do you know the man who fixed our TV?
examples.zh: 你认识修我们电视的那个人吗？

examples.en: The story that he told was very funny.

pages.title: 苏格拉底 · 考点在哪？
pages.question: who lives next door 修饰的是谁？

choices.fb: 对了！who 引导定语从句修饰人。
next door 是地点状语，不是先行词。
先行词是 boy，指人用 who。

pages.sentence: The boy who lives next door is my friend.
pages.zh: 住在隔壁的那个男孩是我的朋友。

pages.title: 规则发现
pages.leftSentence: The girl who sings well is my sister.
pages.leftZh: 唱歌好的那个女孩是我姐姐。
pages.rightSentence: The book which is on the desk is mine.
pages.discovery: who 指人；which/that 指物；定语从句紧跟先行词，说明是哪一个。

pages.title: 规则卡
pages.lead: 关系代词 who / which / that。

rules.rule: 先行词是人 → who + 从句
rules.sample: The boy who lives next door is my friend.
rules.sampleZh: 住在隔壁的那个男孩是我的朋友。

rules.rule: 先行词是物 → which 或 that + 从句
rules.sample: The book which is on the desk is mine.

pages.title: 限时快选 · PSLE 真题
pages.q: The girl _____ won the race is from our class.
pages.hint: 先行词 the girl 指人，用 who。
